places.name: Purple Planet
places.at: on a faraway planet with a purple sky
places.flavor: Two moons hung overhead, winking like sleepy eyes.

places.name: Block Castle
places.at: inside a huge castle built from colourful blocks
places.flavor: Every tower wobbled a little, as if it were laughing.

places.name: Deep Ocean
places.at: at the bottom of the sparkling ocean
places.flavor: Glowing jellyfish drifted past like floating lanterns.

places.name: Secret Lab
places.at: in a secret laboratory under a mountain
places.flavor: Test tubes bubbled and fizzed in every colour of the rainbow.

places.name: Magic Library
places.at: inside a magical library with no ceiling
places.flavor: Paper birds fluttered between the shelves, flapping their pages.

places.name: Floating Island
places.at: on a floating island high above the clouds
places.flavor: Tiny rainbows hopped from cloud to cloud.

places.name: Starship
places.at: aboard a starship zooming past Saturn
places.flavor: The rings of Saturn flashed by the window like a spinning record.

places.name: Volcano Island
places.at: on an island with a sleepy, grumbling volcano
places.flavor: The volcano burped out puffs of warm, glittery smoke.

places.name: Red Desert
places.at: in a red desert dotted with giant cacti
places.flavor: Two suns baked the sand, and little dust whirlwinds twirled about like dancers.

places.name: Snowy Peak
places.at: at the top of a snowy mountain
places.flavor: Snowflakes drifted down and sparkled like tiny stars.

problems.name: Missing stars
problems.title: The Missing Stars
problems.start: all the stars in the sky blinked out, one by one
problems.cause: a sleepy comet had gobbled them up like popcorn
problems.solve: tickled the comet until it giggled, and every star popped back into the sky

problems.name: Confetti monster
problems.title: The Confetti Monster
problems.start: a giant green monster stomped in, hissing like a kettle
problems.cause: the monster was only hissing because it was scared of the dark
problems.solve: gave the monster a night-light, and it burst into happy confetti

problems.name: Upside-down maps
problems.title: The Upside-Down Map
problems.start: every map in the world flipped upside down
problems.cause: a mischievous breeze had turned all the maps over while everyone slept
problems.solve: turned the biggest map the right way up, and everyone finally knew where to go

problems.name: Vanishing books
problems.title: The Vanishing Books
problems.start: every book on the shelves vanished without a trace
problems.cause: a bookworm as big as a bus was nibbling on the stories
problems.solve: read the bookworm a bedtime story, and it burped every book back out

problems.name: Grumpy rocket
problems.title: The Grumpy Rocket
problems.start: the rocket refused to start, no matter which buttons were pushed
problems.cause: the rocket was grumpy because nobody had said good morning to it
problems.solve: said a cheerful good morning, and the rocket purred to life

problems.name: Hungry slime
problems.title: The Hungry Slime
problems.start: a gooey green slime began gobbling up everything in sight
problems.cause: the slime was hungry because it had lost its favourite snack, a golden brick
problems.solve: found the golden brick under a cushion, and the slime shrank to the size of a marble

problems.name: Broken bridge
problems.title: The Broken Bridge
problems.start: a thunderstorm snapped the only bridge in half
problems.cause: the storm cloud was sulking because it had lost its umbrella
problems.solve: built a rainbow bridge from bricks, and the cloud cheered up at last

problems.name: Glowing egg
problems.title: The Glowing Egg
problems.start: a glowing egg began to wobble and crack
problems.cause: inside was a baby star that had never seen the sky
problems.solve: carried the baby star up high, and it twinkled a big thank you

problems.name: Silent world
problems.title: The Silent Song
problems.start: every sound in the world went quiet, even the birds
problems.cause: a shy cloud had tucked every sound into its pocket
problems.solve: told the cloud a joke, and every sound came tumbling out in a joyful chorus

problems.name: Lost colours
problems.title: The Colour Thief
problems.start: all the colours drained out of the world, leaving everything grey
problems.cause: a sneaky raven had collected them to decorate its nest
problems.solve: swapped a shiny button for the colours, and the world burst back into rainbow

helpers.name: a magic flashlight
helpers.power: Its beam was so bright that every shadow ran away giggling.

helpers.name: a super toolbox
helpers.power: It could build anything, from a staircase to a flying sofa.

helpers.name: a talking space frog
helpers.power: The frog croaked clever advice from under a tiny helmet.

helpers.name: a rocket-powered backpack
helpers.power: It went WHOOSH and zoomed over every obstacle.

helpers.name: a book that answers questions
helpers.power: Its pages whispered the answer to anything, as long as the question was polite.

helpers.name: a pet slime named Gloop
helpers.power: Gloop could stretch like a rubber band and squeeze through the smallest gap.

helpers.name: a pair of gravity boots
helpers.power: They let the wearer stroll up walls and across ceilings.

helpers.name: a magic brick
helpers.power: It could turn into any tool, any vehicle, or even a sandwich.

helpers.name: a kite that could fly through anything
helpers.power: It tugged its owner over mountains and through clouds without a single bump.

helpers.name: a telescope that sees around corners
helpers.power: Through it, even the tiniest secret popped into view.

feelings: not giving up, no matter what
eager to find out and learn

sillyThings: waddled past in tiny party hats
blocked the path until someone told a joke
buzzed around and tickled everyone's ears
rolled in and asked for directions to the Moon
knocked politely and asked if anyone had seen their slippers
celebrations: That night, everyone held a feast with pancakes, pizza, and a cake shaped like a rocket.
The crowd cheered so loudly that the echo travelled across three galaxies.
They celebrated with a dance party that lasted until the moons went to bed.
A parade of tiny trumpeting mice marched through to say thank you.
morals: Even the smallest hero can fix the biggest problem
Asking questions is the first step to solving anything
Teamwork turns scary things into silly things
Reading and learning are real superpowers
Being kind is the best kind of magic
